configuration.averaging: Macro average over successfully completed eligible queries, separately for each stage/level.
configuration.mrr_definition: Reciprocal first-gold rank within top 20; zero when absent.
configuration.recall_definition: Distinct gold source IDs in the first k chunk positions divided by all gold source IDs.
configuration.hit_definition: One if any correct source occurs in the first k positions; zero otherwise.
configuration.unindexed_gold_policy: Gold items without indexed chunks remain in the recall denominator.
configuration.error_policy: Failed, blocked and unattempted stages have null metrics; they are not retrieval misses.
configuration.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN context citations are not gold. Queries without resolved gold evidence are excluded.
